title: Round HUD
note: One HUD for the whole round, the MVP's (the engineer's decisions of 2026-10-20 in docs/ui-decisions.md, the sketch pages/mvp-screens frames 1, 1a, 3 and 4 at 0.75: every sketch length x 1.5). s9 hides and returns the same nodes; s1 and s6 draw them as context. Every node has mouse_filter IGNORE. The top: the time and the anger meter side by side in one ToyPlate row, the own side at the top left, every player at the top right. No points on the HUD (they show only on the mutation workbench, s11). The HUD never shows keys, walking or running, who knocked the player down, who killed whom (the engineer, 2026-10-21), a destination or task progress. HUD edges sit 39 px in (the sketch's 26 x 1.5).

states.label: Порожні руки
states.note: An alien with nothing carried; the crosshair is on an extinguisher within reach; the anger is calm (the siren off).

states.label: Предмети
states.note: Fireworks in the hand and a bun on the belt, each with its name tag; the anger rises (the siren on).

states.label: Очима людини
states.note: A human's view: the danger role tile, the other humans tagged in the roster, a battery in the hand. A teammate's name plate keeps the old dissident mark as a visible placeholder: whether a mark over another human's head is still needed beside the roster's tag is open.

states.label: Мало здоровʼя й сил
states.note: Health at 0.22 (two of ten pips, under the 30 % alarm line: ToyPipAlarm and the danger label) and stamina at 0.18 (two pips).

states.label: Підняття
states.note: Decided by the engineer (2026-10-06, the wave-19 question page, q9): what the raiser sees while holding Interact next to a downed player. A thin progress bar under the crosshair in place of the object name, filling at the same rate as the downed player's raise bar (s9 raise); no text.

states.label: Копи за хвилину
states.note: The anger is full: the neighbours called the cops, and the whole party sees the countdown. Open: whether the round timer still shows beside the cops' minute, or only the one that ends first; how long the minute is.

nodes.name: Plates
nodes.note: The name plate layer (#257), under the rest of the HUD: one Plate per other player in line of sight within about 10 m. Code: position = camera.unproject_position(head + 0.35 m), the plate centred on it; hidden behind walls (raycast), beyond 10 m or behind the camera. No role, no health.

children.name: Plate
children.note: One instance per visible player, moved every frame to the projected point (the sample sits over another human at about 538, 302).

children.name: Name
children.note: The player's name from code (auto_translate_mode DISABLED); no translated text.

children.name: Mark
children.note: PLACEHOLDER, open: the old dissident mark, on a human's client over another human only. Whether a mark over another human's head is still needed beside the roster's tag is the engineer's choice; drop this node if not.

children.name: Role
children.note: The player's own side for the round, a word tile 39 px in (the sketch's 26 x 1.5): ToySticker with role.alien, ToyStickerAlert (the danger outline) with role.human.

children.name: Time
children.note: ui-2.0.0 (the target page pages/suit-final, frames 5 and 6): the time and the neighbours' anger in one tile at the top centre, 36 px down (24 x 1.5): the time in Unbounded, then the anger meter A (the bar and its siren). The caption hud.anger («Гнів сусідів», the engineer's word, 2026-10-22) sits over the bar in ToyHudCaption, in ToyTextAlertOnLight past the alarm line (agent).

children.name: Timer
children.note: The round time, m:ss from code (auto_translate_mode DISABLED), every second; light on the tile (no halo).

children.name: Caption
children.note: The meter's name; the danger colour with the bar past its alarm line (70 %).

children.name: Bar
children.note: The anger meter (A): ToyBarAngerCalm (a muted grey fill) and, past the alarm line (70 %), ToyBarAngerAlarm (the danger fill); no glow and no pulse since ui-2.0.0.

children.name: Siren
children.note: icons/siren-off.svg (dim) while calm, icons/siren-on.svg (the danger colour) while the anger rises and when full; never tinted.

children.name: Roster
children.note: Every player of the round with the body colour (decided 2026-10-20), 39 px in at the top right; at least 285 wide (the sketch's 190 x 1.5), growing to its longest row. The rows are built from the player list in the session's order with the own row first; a row updates when a player dies, comes back or leaves. Names are data and are not cut. Open: whether the dead show here (the page shows them dimmed with a mark).

children.name: Row1
children.note: One row: Dot is ToyRosterDot, a white disc the game tints to the player's body colour (self_modulate from data); Name is the player's name (auto_translate_mode DISABLED), the own one through hud.roster.self in ToyRosterNameSelf (the accent), a dead player's through hud.roster.dead in ToyRosterNameDead (dim), else the bare name in ToyRosterName. In a human's roster the other humans and the own row carry Tag (role.human, the danger colour); an alien's roster has no tags (humans know each other, decided 2026-10-20).

children.name: Cross
children.note: The crosshair dot, centred on the screen (its size is the variation's).

children.name: Raising
children.note: See the state raising. Shown while the player holds Interact on a downed player, in place of Aim; hidden when the key is released or the player is up. Its top sits as Aim's.

children.name: Bar
children.note: The raise progress (0 to 1), the same value the downed player's s9 Downed/V/Raise shows.

children.name: Aim
children.note: The name of the object under the crosshair within reach (an item.* key, item.extinguisher here; a mischief station or a machine takes its own key when the game adds one); hidden when nothing within reach is under the crosshair. Centred 64 px under the screen's centre, so its top is the sketch's 22 x 1.5 = 33 px under it.

children.name: Edge
children.note: ui-2.0.0 (the target page's frame 7): the cops' minute is the one loud moment inside the round: a 12 px danger edge around the whole screen (8 x 1.5), its middle clear, over the HUD's world and under its tiles.

children.name: Cops
children.note: The cops' minute (m8 §5.3): when the anger fills, the neighbours call the cops and every player sees this danger tile (ui-2.0.0: the danger face, its 8 px deeper bottom edge, the danger ink), 168 px down (the sketch's 112 x 1.5), until the cops arrive (the round ends, s10 cops) or the aliens finish first. Stalling the cops is not in the MVP.

children.name: Count
children.note: The time until the cops arrive, m:ss from code (auto_translate_mode DISABLED), every second.

children.name: Vitals
children.note: The suit tile and the mic beside it, 39 px in at the bottom left. Always shown in a round. Health and stamina are ten pips each (the engineer's segmented pips, 2026-10-21), no numbers: health on top in the accent, stamina under it in the text colour, each with its label; the count of full pips is the real cue, the colour only adds to it.

children.name: Suit
children.note: ui-2.0.0 (the engineer's segmented pips; the target page's suit tile): health and stamina as ten pips each, round(value x 10) of them full. Health full pips are ToyPipHealth, under its alarm line (30 %) ToyPipAlarm with its label ToyTextAlertOnLight; stamina pips are ToyPipStamina. The game sets each pip's variation from the value.

children.name: Title
children.note: The tile's name over the pips, hud.suit («Костюм», the engineer's word, 2026-10-22), in the captions' dim style (agent).

children.name: Mic
children.note: Whether anyone hears the player. On: mic.svg tinted icon_on. Off (mic off, push-to-talk released, downed, pre and post game): mic-off.svg tinted icon_off (the danger colour). 42 px in the 75 px badge.

children.name: Slots
children.note: ui-2.0.0 (the target page's frame 5): the hand and the belt as tiles 117 x 132 (78 x 88 x 1.5), 36 px from the corner, 16 px apart; the picture is the item's line icon (icons/item-*.svg, the white copy tinted: the accent in the hand, the text colour on the belt) and the name sits inside the tile at its bottom (no tag over the edge).
